propositions: Guardrail-intervened or content-policy-blocked LLM calls are classified as CHANGE_INPUT but rendered with a generic 'too large / malformed' message that misdirects operators to the wrong remedy.

The message_for() function must distinguish content-filter finish_reason blocks from genuine size/malformed CHANGE_INPUT cases by adding an optional finish_reason parameter and returning a specific content-filter message when both conditions are met.

The finish_reason parameter must be threaded through message_for() call sites in _cli/_llm_commands.py and close_precheck.py from available LLMOutcome.diagnostic and persisted coverage diagnostic fields.
Backward compatibility is preserved: message_for() called with only resolution_class returns the generic message, and non-content_filter CHANGE_INPUT cases retain their original message.
